<?php
class DeepParent137 {
    public $value = 7 {
        &get { echo "G|"; return $this->value; }
    }
}
class DeepChild137 extends DeepParent137 {
    public $value = 11;
}
class DeepGrandchild137 extends DeepChild137 {
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}
class DeepGreatgrandchild137 extends DeepGrandchild137 {}
echo "X:";
$child = new DeepGreatgrandchild137;
$alias =& $child->value;
echo $alias === 11 ? "alias11|" : "bad-initial|";
$alias = "word";
echo $child->value === "word" ? "live-word|" : "bad-live|";
unset($child);
echo "Z|";

<?php
class ChainParent138 {
    public $value = 7 {
        &get { echo "G:", __CLASS__, "/", static::class, "|"; return $this->value; }
    }
}
class ChainChild138 extends ChainParent138 { public $value = 11; }
class ChainMiddle138 extends ChainChild138 {}
class ChainLeaf138 extends ChainMiddle138 {
    public $value = 21;
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}
echo "U:";
$object = new ChainLeaf138;
$alias =& $object->value;
echo $alias === 21 ? "alias21|" : "bad-alias|";
$alias = "word";
$copy = $object->value;
$alias = 23;
echo $copy === "word" ? "copy-word|" : "bad-copy|";
echo $object->value === 23 ? "live23|" : "bad-live|";
unset($object);
$alias = "free";
echo $alias === "free" ? "free|" : "bad-free|";
echo $copy === "word" ? "copy-still-word|Z|" : "bad-copy-after|";

<?php

    public int $value = 7 {
        &get { echo "G:", __CLASS__, "/", static::class, "|"; return $this->value; }

}

class TypedMiddle138 extends TypedChild138 {}

    public int $value = 21;
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}
echo "T:";
$object = new TypedLeaf138;
$alias =& $object->value;
echo $alias === 21 ? "alias21|" : "bad-alias|";
$alias = "22";
echo $alias === 22 ? "coerced22|" : "bad-coercion|";
try {
    $alias = [];
    echo "bad-array|";
} catch (TypeError $error) {
    echo "type:", $error->getMessage(), "|";
}
echo $alias === 22 ? "kept22|" : "bad-value|";
unset($object);
$alias = "free";
echo $alias === "free" ? "free|Z|" : "bad-free|";

<?php

    public $value = 7 {

class RebindLeaf138 extends RebindMiddle138 {
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}
echo "R:";
$object = new RebindLeaf138;
$replacement = 17;
try {
    $object->value =& $replacement;
    echo "bad-rebind|";
} catch (Error $error) {
    echo "error:", $error->getMessage(), "|";
    echo $error->getLine() === 16 ? "line|" : "bad-line|";
    echo $error->getFile() === __FILE__ ? "file|" : "bad-file|";
}
echo $object->value === 41 ? "kept41|" : "bad-value|";
$replacement = 19;
echo $object->value === 41 ? "separate41|" : "bad-rebound|";
echo $replacement === 19 ? "rhs19|" : "bad-rhs|";
